_about: Fictional mailbox for the hybrid ranking eval (examples/hybrid_eval.rs). Every person and domain is invented; domains are .example. `days` = days before the eval runs. Default labels: INBOX.

messages.subject: Re: Lease renewal — 418 Alder St, Unit 3B
messages.body: Great. Attached is the signed lease renewal for June 1 through May 31 next year. Rent stays at $2,450 a month. Keep a copy for your records.

messages.subject: Question about the lease
messages.body: Hi Mike, if my job moves me out of state next year, what are my options for leaving before the term is up?

messages.subject: Re: Question about the lease
messages.body: Good question. Section 14 covers early termination: you give 60 days written notice and pay a fee equal to one month's rent, and the rest of the lease is released. A job relocation letter waives half the fee.
